summary: Fence worktree activation against concurrent megarepo build-output reclamation

schema.detail: No storage, client schema or code generation changes.

compatibility.detail: Checkout creation and reuse, reconciliation rendering and runtime initialization, cargo-test gates, and web snapshot activation hold an mr store lease through publication and failure cleanup. Activation refuses when mr cannot acquire admission. The installed mr must include effect-utils f2b187c4 or newer, including --repo-path and descendant reentrancy.

downtime.detail: No additional downtime beyond the normal binary restart.

manual.detail: Make the pinned mr CLI available to the daemon login environment and web activation launcher before upgrading.

recovery.detail: Binary swap-back requires no data migration.
